name_zh: 穆吉布/孟加拉解放战争/独立运动/后冲突重建
description_zh: 谢赫·穆吉布·拉赫曼 (1920-1975) 孟加拉国父，领导孟加拉解放战争，实现从巴基斯坦独立，建立孟加拉人民共和国，实行民主社会主义，进行后冲突重建，奠定现代孟加拉国基础，被称为'孟加拉之虎'。
description_en: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman (1920-1975) Father of the Nation of Bangladesh, led Bangladesh Liberation War, achieved independence from Pakistan, established People's Republic of Bangladesh, implemented democratic socialism, conducted post-conflict reconstruction, laid foundation for modern Bangladesh, known as 'Bangabandhu'.
reason_zh: 穆吉布代表后冲突民主主修复如何重塑国家治理模式，展示了民族独立运动如何建立新的政治体系，其民主社会主义影响了孟加拉发展道路，其重建模式影响了后冲突国家建设，其国父地位塑造了孟加拉国家认同。
reason_en: Mujib represents how post-conflict democratic reconstruction reshapes national governance model, demonstrates how independence movements establish new political systems, his democratic socialism influenced Bangladesh development path, his reconstruction model influences post-conflict nation building, his founding father status shapes Bangladeshi national identity.
steps_zh: 研究穆吉布早年/学生运动/政治崛起
分析1947-1970年巴基斯坦时期/六点纲领/语言运动
探讨1971年解放战争/独立宣言/国际支持
评估1972-1975年建国/民主社会主义/国家建设
总结独立遗产/民主传统/经济发展/文化认同
steps_en: Study Mujib early years/student movement/political rise
Analyze 1947-1970 Pakistan period/Six Points Program/language movement
Summarize independence legacy/democratic tradition/economic development/cultural identity
expected_zh: 理解后冲突民主主修复如何重塑国家治理模式，掌握民族独立运动如何建立新的政治体系，评估民主社会主义对孟加拉发展的影响，认识建国模式在后冲突国家建设中的作用。
expected_en: Understand how post-conflict democratic reconstruction reshapes national governance model, grasp how independence movements establish new political systems, evaluate democratic socialism impact on Bangladesh development, recognize state-building model role in post-conflict nation construction.
case_zh: 1948年语言运动；1970年选举胜利；1971年独立宣言；1972年宪法制定。民族独立/民主社会主义/后冲突重建/国家认同。
case_en: 1948 Language Movement; 1970 Election Victory; 1971 Independence Declaration; 1972 Constitution. National independence/Democratic socialism/Post-conflict reconstruction/National identity.
cross_cultural_impact: South Asian independence/Bengali nationalism/Regional cooperation/Development economics/Cultural identity
artistic_legacy: 是: 国家象征/文学形象
conflict_resolution_mechanism: 民主协商/国际调解/发展导向
